name: A shell/exec-style tool's own 'command' argument legitimately contains shell syntax
notes: TODOS #50 FP guard, the exact scenario the key-scoping exists to protect: a legitimate execute_command-style MCP tool's whole purpose is to run a shell command, so its argument value routinely carries `;`/`|`/`&&`. Because the key ('command') is not identifier-shaped, shell-metachar-in-identifier-arg must not fire here — a blanket value-only scan would have made this entire tool class unusable.
